summary: Iteration 121 tested newbiz 90-day trial + Super Admin trial-kind enrichment + Welcome Congrats modal + signup badge. Backend enrichment (trial_kind newbiz90/trial7/trial30, trial_days_left, referred_by_name) verified via pytest (3/3 pass). Frontend: Super Admin Tenants tab shows all 6 trial-filter chips, badges (🌱 New-Biz 90d, 7-day trial, 30-day trial) with correct testids, ⏳ days-left pills, and newbiz filter correctly narrows list to only the newbiz tenant. Signup badge switches between '90-Day Free Setup · New Business Offer' (with ?offer=newbiz) and '7-Day Free Trial · No credit card' (fresh storage). Congrats modal appears on newbiz tenant dashboard login with correct 90-day copy, refer & close buttons — behavior fully rendered.

issues: Field label is 'Username' but placeholder is 'you@example.com' (input type=email). Cosmetic; consider renaming label to 'Email'.

Two modals can stack: the platform 'What's New ✨' What's-new dialog opens on top of / alongside the WelcomeCongratsModal, which may confuse a new-biz owner. Consider gating the What's-New popup until after congrats is dismissed for first-time newbiz signups.

action_items: OPTIONAL/VERIFY: Confirm WelcomeCongratsModal one-shot persistence — during testing the modal appeared correctly on first dashboard load with correct 90-day copy + Refer/Close buttons, but one repro attempt appeared to have the modal still counted after a close click + reload; this could be because the 'What's New' modal overlay intercepted the close click. Manually verify: close congrats → reload dashboard → confirm modal does NOT reappear (localStorage key miracurl_congrats_seen_<tenantId> is set after dismiss). Login flakiness in the automation harness prevented a fully clean re-test.
OPTIONAL: Stagger What's-New and WelcomeCongrats modals so they don't co-mount for new-biz owners on first dashboard load.
critical_code_review_comments: WelcomeCongratsModal.jsx line 25 uses `Date.now() - created > 30 * 86400000` to suppress modal for tenants older than 30 days — for newbiz90 tenants this cutoff is fine (they're brand-new), but if a newbiz owner delays first login past 30 days they'd never see the welcome message. Consider bumping to 45–60 days or gating solely by the localStorage-seen key.

super_admin_ops.py list_tenants uses date arithmetic on trial_end_date; wrapped in try/except (ValueError, TypeError) which is correct. Consider adding a log warning when parsing fails to catch corrupted tenant docs.

SignupSalon.jsx stores 'miracurl_offer' in localStorage indefinitely — could cause a stale 90-day badge to appear on a later visit without the query param (verified in test). Not incorrect (intentional 'sticky offer'), but consider TTL of ~7 days so old offers don't linger.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs blocking. Minor UX concern: What's-New and WelcomeCongrats modals both mount on first dashboard load; the What's-New modal's darker overlay may intercept the congrats close-btn click causing users to think the congrats didn't dismiss.
